verdict.rationale: An infrastructure-as-code tool could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as explanations of plans or state, so this story applies to OpenTofu. The evidence pack contains nothing showing AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product. `tofu plan` previews and `tofu test` assertions are deterministic features, not AI-driven ones, and earn no credit.
